WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

SELECT 'sales' AS tbl, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_line,
       SUM(CASE WHEN etl_loaded_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_loaded, MIN(sale_date) AS min_d, MAX(sale_date) AS max_d
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26') OR (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0, MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line
WHERE (return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26') OR (return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')

-- Savonlinna daily sales around closing, and the Q3 control comparison by store/year
WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS v
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), m AS (
  SELECT store_id, business_date, SUM(v) AS mine FROM mine GROUP BY ALL
), c AS (
  SELECT store_id, business_date, net_sales AS ctrl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
)
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.business_date,c.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'FY25/26 Q3' ELSE 'FY24/25 Q3' END AS yr,
       COUNT(*) AS store_days, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mine,0)),2) AS mine_total, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ctrl,0)),2) AS ctrl_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(mine,0)-COALESCE(ctrl,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched_store_days
FROM m FULL JOIN c ON m.store_id=c.store_id AND m.business_date=c.business_date
WHERE COALESCE(m.business_date,c.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
   OR COALESCE(m.business_date,c.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26'
GROUP BY 1

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS v
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.store_id, r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), m AS (
  SELECT store_id, business_date, SUM(v) AS mine FROM mine GROUP BY ALL
), c AS (
  SELECT store_id, business_date, net_sales AS ctrl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
), j AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, COALESCE(m.business_date,c.business_date) AS d, mine, ctrl
  FROM m FULL JOIN c ON m.store_id=c.store_id AND m.business_date=c.business_date
  WHERE COALESCE(m.business_date,c.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
     OR COALESCE(m.business_date,c.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26'
)
SELECT store_id >= 900 AS non_physical, COUNT(*) AS store_days, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mine,0)),2) AS mine_total, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ctrl,0)),2) AS ctrl_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(mine,0)-COALESCE(ctrl,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched,
       MIN(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(mine,0)-COALESCE(ctrl,0))>0.05 THEN d END) AS first_mismatch, MAX(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(mine,0)-COALESCE(ctrl,0))>0.05 THEN d END) AS last_mismatch
FROM j GROUP BY 1
